name: Lehmer's totient problem: a Lehmer number has at least 16 prime factors (partial result)
target: If phi(n) | n - 1 and n is composite then omega(n) >= 16
result: Proved by hand except a finite check done by two independent programs; Lehmer's problem itself stays open.

notes.formal: Lean proves the lemmas and several statements in full, not the omega(n) >= 16 search
notes.human: J. Number Theory and Math. Comp. rejected it as partial; the journal version (eLhmr 1.4.0, 44 pages) is prepared for the International Journal of Number Theory
notes.code: the equivalent assertion and the two constraints on the divisor D are checked in construct/lehmer_equiv.py
